instructions.primary_message: Cut butter into small pieces. Place in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment; set aside to soften.
Place flour, pumpkin spice mix, cream of tartar, baking soda, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dry ingredients and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups all-purpose flour
1 ½ tsp pumpkin spice mix
½ tsp cream of tartar
½ tsp baking soda
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the butter has softened, beat on medium-high speed until light and creamy, 2-3 minutes. Stop the mixer and scrape down the sides of the bowl with a silicone spatula.

Reduce mixer to medium speed and continue to beat the butter, slowly adding sugar a few tablespoons at a time, until light in color and fluffy in texture, 3-5 minutes more. Stop the mixer and scrape down the sides of the bowl.
Crack egg into the bowl with the butter mixture, then add vanilla. Mix on medium speed until fully combined. Stop the mixer and scrape down the sides of the bowl.
Add dry ingredients to the bowl. Mix on low speed until just combined. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and place in the fridge to chill for a minimum of 1 hour or overnight.
Once the dough has chilled, preheat oven to 350°F. Line two large baking sheet pans with parchment paper. (Bake in batches, if necessary, depending on the size of your baking sheet pans.)
Place sugar and pumpkin spice mix in a small bowl. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup granulated sugar
1 ½ tsp pumpkin spice mix

instructions.primary_message: Working one at a time, using a rounded tablespoon measure, roll dough into balls. Add dough balls to the bowl with the pumpkin spice sugar and roll to coat. Transfer sugar-coated cookies to the baking sheets, spacing them 2 ½-inches apart. Using the flat bottom of a drinking glass, press down on each ball to flatten the cookies to 1/4-inch thickness.
Place baking sheets in the oven and bake until cookies are golden around the edges, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool.
To serve, transfer cookies to a platter. Enjoy!
